verdict.rationale: Martin is a cloud-hosted personal-assistant SaaS. Self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment. A community user describes it as a 'cloud-based agent', and another user asks for an open-source system, which suggests none exists; neither counts as support for self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
